_meta.note: Anonymized UniFi controller response fixture (single controller sysinfo object). MACs are 02:00: pseudo MACs, LAN IPs are TEST-NET (192.0.2.x), SSIDs are home-main/home-iot/home-6g, AP names are AP-N, ObjectIds are 5f00-prefixed, epoch timestamps are shifted by a constant, secret fields are REDACTED. Structure mirrors the real endpoint. Controller hostname/serial identifiers removed.
_meta.ap_names: AP fixtures use AP-1..AP-N; product model codes (U6ENT, UALR6v2, UAPA697) are UniFi product names.
